teaching_goal: Explain when proofreading and mismatch repair each happen

review_notes.hook_claim: L20-p1: proofreading happens as bases are added; mismatch repair after replication is complete.
review_notes.analogy: Fixing typos as you type, then rereading the essay after.

scenes.title: Proofreading vs. mismatch repair
scenes.narration: Picture one round of copying as a timeline. While copying happens, DNA polymerase proofreads. It fixes a wrong base right away. Now copying is done. After that, mismatch repair proteins scan the finished DNA. They fix wrong bases they find. It's like fixing typos as you type, then rereading the essay after. Proofreading is during. Mismatch repair is after. Now try the question again.
